title: Affine tag decoding with fixed side list sizes (1, 2, 2, 2) and packed displacement and weight scoring with shortlist records in leader words and exact ranks through weight eleven

claims.statement: The explicit affine tag product encoder with the (1, 2, 2, 2) fixed-size relative-list pair decoder in proof.md has average block error at most 999265000537814199/1000000000000000000 on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses for uniform 1000-bit messages.
The same fixed bsc-ops-v1 program executes exactly W=4004 primitives on all received words, with W<=2^(1196723/100000).

experiments.purpose: Verify this sector of all local tag spectra and exact quotient ranks through weight eleven. The last sector also checks the global occupancy and the fixed schedule.
